result.title: Reference-Guided Data Curation for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pretraining
result.summary: Training 3D vision-language models (VLMs) on large medical imaging datasets collected across institutions is constrained by data quality. Vast, uncurated pools of image-report pairs are characterized by redundancy, class imbalance, and cross-institutional heterogeneity. We address this challenge of data curation for improving 3D VLM pretraining by proposing an offline, training-free, reference-guided data curation recipe. Our approach leverages a small, high-quality reference set to independently extract quality signals for each modality of a large, uncurated pool and merges them through a rank-aggregation step into a single ranking that guides sample selection. We validate this method on datasets comprising 35k 3D abdominal CT volume-report pairs from two institutions and 58k 2D chest X-ray image-report pairs. On 3D CT, using our reference-guided data curation strategy, our curated model matches the zero-shot disease classification performance of a state-of-the-art baseline (Merlin) while using $3.3\times$ less training data and a reference set of 5k samples. On 2D chest X-rays, our method yields a curated model that matches or exceeds the zero-shot disease classification performance of a model trained on the full pool while using up to $10\times$ less training data and a reference set of only 74 samples. Ablations show that the selection is stable under resampling of the reference, that smaller reference sets still outperform random sampling, and that label rebalancing does not improve performance. To support reproducibility, we release our code.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种离线、免训练的参考集引导数据筛选方法：借助小型高质量参考集分别为图像与报告提取质量信号，再通过秩聚合得到单一排序，用于从大规模未整理医学图文对中挑选训练样本；在3D腹部CT与2D胸片上验证了少量数据下的零样本疾病分类性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身是医学VLM预训练的数据整理工作，不涉及latent推理状态或证据使用；但其「参考集打分＋秩聚合选样」的思路，可能可供核查是否适用于筛选推理轨迹或高价值训练样本、以及相应的监督分配。
